title.narrative: Strengthening CITES Implementation Through Priority CoP17 Decisions and Resolutions

description.narrative: This project will provide funding to the CITES Secretariat located in Geneva, Switzerland to execute activities that carry out Decisions and Resolutions adopted by the CITES Parties to combat wildlife trafficking and strengthen CITES implementation. During the CITES CoP and Standing Committee meetings, priority activities were adopted subject to available funding. Funding from the core budget of CITES is not sufficient to support the activities and thus the Secretariat seeks funding from Parties to the Convention and other donors. The activities identified are of high priority to the United States for combating wildlife trafficking, including: reducing demand for illegal wildlife products, supporting the adoption of national legislation relevant to the Convention, assisting Management Authorities with CITES compliance and enforcement, supporting the development of technologies that will improve the management of CITES trade, and increasing protections for priority CITES-listed endangered species traded illegally.
